g.text: MS03 · Alertas y Emergencias — Diagrama Entidad-Relación

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(15, 42, 74), rgb(184, 207, 234)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(15, 42, 74), rgb(184, 207, 234));
fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(15, 42, 74), rgb(184, 207, 234));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 602px; height: 1px; padding-top: 617px; margin-left: 624px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
PK alerts_pkey (id)
CK ck_alerts_status: status IN ('DRAFT','SCHEDULED','ACTIVE','ARCHIVED')
CK ck_alerts_origin: origin IN ('MANUAL','SIMULATION')
CK ck_alerts_title_not_blank: length(btrim(title)) > 0
CK ck_alerts_instructions_not_blank: length(btrim(instructions)) > 0
CK ck_alerts_simulation_id: (SIMULATION AND simulation_id NOT NULL)
OR (MANUAL AND simulation_id IS NULL)
CK ck_alerts_scheduled_has_date: status <> 'SCHEDULED' OR activation_at IS NOT NULL
CK ck_alerts_active_has_date: status <> 'ACTIVE' OR activated_at IS NOT NULL
CK ck_alerts_archived_has_date: status <> 'ARCHIVED' OR archived_at IS NOT NULL

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 602px; height: 1px; padding-top: 785px; margin-left: 624px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
UQ parcial uq_alerts_simulation_purpose_live: (simulation_id, COALESCE(purpose,''))
WHERE simulation_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('SCHEDULED','ACTIVE')
IDX idx_alerts_status_activation_at: (status, activation_at)
IDX idx_alerts_status_activated_at: (status, activated_at)
IDX idx_alerts_created_at: (created_at DESC)
IDX idx_alerts_simulation_id: (simulation_id) WHERE simulation_id IS NOT NULL
IDX idx_alerts_simulation_purpose: (simulation_id, purpose)

FK fk_scope_items_alert (alert_id) -> alerts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
UQ uq_scope_items_alert_ref (alert_id, scope_type, scope_ref_id) NULLS NOT DISTINCT
CK ck_scope_items_type: scope_type IN ('CAMPUS','BUILDING','ZONE')
CK ck_scope_items_ref: (CAMPUS AND ref IS NULL) OR (BUILDING/ZONE AND ref IS NOT NULL)

CK ck_recipients_type: recipient_type IN ('USER','ROLE')
